instructions: Blueprint is an accessible React design system. Before writing UI: call list_components / get_component to use an existing component, find_token for every colour, space or radius (never raw values or primitive tokens), check_contrast for any new colour pairing, and run lint_ui on the code you wrote before returning it.

tools.name: list_components
tools.title: List components
tools.description: Every Blueprint component with its category and a one-line summary.

tools.name: get_component
tools.title: Get a component
tools.description: Props (with allowed values), anatomy, accessibility guarantees, do / don't guidance and the import path for one component.

tools.name: find_token
tools.title: Find a token
tools.description: The token for an intent, e.g. "error text", "card background", "espacio entre secciones". Semantic tokens rank first; primitives are only for the semantic layer itself.

intent.description: What the value is for, in English or Spanish

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.title: Check contrast
tools.description: WCAG 2.2 contrast between two colours — token names or hex — in a theme. Reports 1.4.3 (text), 1.4.11 (UI edges) and 1.4.6 (AAA).

tools.name: lint_ui
tools.title: Lint UI code
tools.description: Checks TSX/JSX/CSS against Blueprint: raw colours, primitive or unknown tokens, bare spacing, unknown props, invalid prop values and icon-only controls without a label. Returns findings with suggested fixes.

code.description: The UI code to check (up to 200,000 characters)

resources.name: rules
resources.title: Blueprint rules
resources.description: The rules every Blueprint consumer follows.
